media.title: Add a video or photos
media.hint: One video or up to 5 photos. Photos play 3s each, joined in order. Drag to reorder.
media.imageLimit: You can add up to {{max}} photos.

subtitle.title: Subtitle
subtitle.hint: Create subtitles from the video's audio, a recording, or by typing.
subtitle.textHint: Write a note and we'll split it into subtitles across the video.
subtitle.textPlaceholder: e.g. Paid for lunch with Lightning today

tagChallenge.challengeSearchEmpty: No joined challenges match your search

record.subtitle: Subtitle
record.recordingHint: We'll add your recording as subtitles. Max {{maxSeconds}} sec.
record.recordingHintShort: We'll add your recording as subtitles

caption.proofPhotoHint: Attach a photo to the end of your video to verify your record. It will appear for 3 seconds after upload.

processing.hint: Can take up to 3 minutes. You can switch apps — the upload keeps running.

error.tooShort: This video is {{secs}}s. Only videos 10 seconds or longer can be uploaded.
error.tooLong: This video is {{secs}}s. Only videos 60 seconds or shorter can be uploaded.
error.micNotAllowed: Microphone access was denied. Click the lock icon in the address bar to allow it.
error.micNotFound: No microphone found. Check your device.
error.micUnsupported: Voice recording is not supported in this browser.
error.jobNotFound: Could not confirm upload result. Check your feed for the video.

preview.title: Preview
preview.filterNote: Still-frame preview with effect applied — actual result may differ.

filter.title: Video effects
filter.previewFailed: Couldn't load the preview. The filter will still be applied.

cartoon.title: Cartoon filter
cartoon.hint: Turns your whole video into a cartoon look. Faces and backgrounds are softly simplified.

heat.title: Hash heat
heat.hint: The parts you move most glow red, like hashrate climbing — more intense the more you move.

cartoonHeat.title: Cartoon + hash heat
cartoonHeat.hint: A light cartoon look for privacy, with hash heat layered on top.

footsteps.title: Footsteps
footsteps.hint: Footprints stamp to your walking rhythm with step and floor counters. Great for walks and stairs.
